articles.title: Bitcoin pinned below $73,000 despite potential U.S.-Iran deal news
articles.snippet: U.S. stocks and bonds, and the oil market are reacting positively to yet another purported peace agreement, but crypto markets remain under heavy pressure.

articles.title: Standard Chartered backs $4,000 ether as retail piles into the sub-$2,000 drop
articles.snippet: The bank says onchain metrics will pull the price back up, just as Amazon's stock price recovered after 2001. A retail dip-buying frenzy and a record futures short build say the bottom isn't in yet.

articles.title: Crypto slides on Hormuz airstrikes as $897 million in long liquidations pile up
articles.snippet: BTC dropped to its lowest since April 13 and ETH broke below $2,000 as U.S. airstrikes stoked inflation concerns, wiping out nearly $900 million in leveraged longs.

articles.title: ERC-7943 author says institutions can’t play DeFi’s ‘pirate game’
articles.snippet: RWA standard ERC-7943 reaches final stage as Ethereum builders rethink how institutional finance move onchain.

articles.title: Aave Labs’ Push gains UK FCA crypto registration
articles.snippet: Aave Labs’ Push received FCA approval for “certain cryptoasset activities” in the UK, supporting its plans for regulated stablecoin on- and off-ramping.
